item.title: ianshulyadav/PixelMusic
item.description:
Pixel Music is an open-source Android music player. Stream YouTube Music & Telegram, play Hi-Res lossless FLAC, with synced lyrics & 10-band EQ.

https://pixelmusic.me



PixelMusic is an open-source Android music player that plays music from multiple sources in one place. You can listen to files stored on your device, stream from YouTube Music, play audio from your Telegram channels and chats, or build smart playlists using AI within the same app.

It supports high-resolution local audio formats including FLAC, ALAC, WAV, APE, and MP3. The interface automatically picks its color scheme from the album art of the track that is currently playing. There are no ads and no subscriptions.

Technical Specifications & Capabilities (Expand)
  • Audio Formats: Bit-perfect Hi-Res FLAC, ALAC, WAV, APE (up to 24-bit/192kHz), plus AAC, OPUS, OGG, MP3.
  • Audio Processing: Media3 ExoPlayer with FFmpeg extension, 10-band EQ, Bass Boost, ReplayGain/EBU R128 loudness normalization, gapless playback, and 0–15s crossfade.
  • Sources: Local offline files, YouTube Music (search, stream, library sync), Telegram audio channels/chats, Spotify & YouTube playlist import.
  • Lyrics: LRCLIB synchronized lyrics with millisecond offset adjustment, offline caching, live translation, and phonetic romanization (Pinyin, Romaji, Hangul).
  • Integrations: Android Auto (MediaLibraryService), Chromecast / Google Cast, Wear OS companion app, Last.fm & ListenBrainz scrobbling.
  • Design & UI: 100% Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3 Expressive, dynamic color palettes from album artwork and system wallpapers.
  • AI Features: Smart playlist generator via natural language prompts (supporting Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenAI).
  • License & Requirements: 100% free, no ads, open-source under GNU GPL v3.0. Requires Android 11 (API 30) or above.

Architecture & Full Tech Stack
  • Core Platform: 100% Kotlin 2.x, target SDK 37 (Android 17), min SDK 30 (Android 11)
  • UI & Design: Jetpack Compose, Compose BOM, Material 3 Expressive, Dynamic Theme Palettes
  • Audio Engine: AndroidX Media3 ExoPlayer, FFmpeg Extension, EBU R128 loudness normalization
  • Database & Persistence: Room 2.6+ with KSP, DataStore Preferences
  • Dependency Injection: Dagger Hilt 2.5x
  • Networking & Parsing: Ktor Client, OkHttp, Kotlinx Serialization, Retrofit
  • Image Loading: Coil 3 with memory & disk LRU caching
  • Background Processing: AndroidX WorkManager, Kotlin Coroutines & Flow
git clone https://github.com/ianshulyadav/PixelMusic.git
cd PixelMusic
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug


Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
  • Is PixelMusic completely free and ad-free? Yes, 100% free with no ads, tracking, or paywalls.
  • Does it support Android Auto and Chromecast? Yes, both are natively supported via Media3.
  • Can I play local FLAC/lossless files offline? Yes, up to 24-bit/192kHz with bit-perfect output.
  • How does YouTube Music streaming work? It uses public InnerTube streams with zero account requirements (or optional account sync).
  • Where do lyrics come from? Real-time synchronized lyrics via the LRCLIB API with offline caching.

CREDITS

Special thanks to InnerTube, ArchiveTune, and ViMusic.

The latest version brings official support for the newly released EmbeddingGemma 2 model. With this release, we bring cutting edge, multimodal semantic search running 100% on your device. Try out these new capabilities in our new features Instant Media Search and Video Moment Finder.

Use the Agent Skills tile to augment model capabilities with tools like Wikipedia for fact-grounding, interactive maps, and rich visual summary cards. You can even load modular skills from a URL or browse community contributions on GitHub Discussions.

  • AI Chat with ASR & TTS: Talk to your model instead of typing. Tap the mic button to dictate your message with on-device speech recognition, and tap the speaker on any reply (or turn on auto-play) to hear it read aloud. Choose your speech recognition and text-to-speech engines, voices, and languages in the chat's Audio settings.

  • XR Language Teacher: Learn a new language from the world around you. Point your camera at an object and ask about it by image, voice, or text. item.title: Akshayykadam/PixelBoard
item.description:
Unlock Google 11's Gemini "Rambler" Natural Voice Dictation & AI Writing Tools on ANY Android phone. No root required.

PixelBoard

Supercharged Gboard Mod featuring Google Pixel 11 series's Rambler Voice Typing & AI Writing Assistant [No Root].

  

Overview

PixelBoard is a sleek, ultra-clean enhancement of Google's flagship keyboard. Tailored for pure productivity, PixelBoard strips away unnecessary bloatware and focuses strictly on powerhouse capabilities: Gemini Rambler Natural Voice Dictation, AI Writing Assistant, Modern Spell Checker Suggestion Chips & Grammar Checking, Scan Text Camera OCR, Screenshot Floating Suggestions, Material 3 Expressive Rounded Keys, Google Sans Flex Keycap Typography, Proactive Undo in Suggestion Strip, Emoji Palette V2, Super Insert Quick Hub, Restored Emoji Size Slider & Vibrant Emojis, Samsung & Vivo Clipboard History Sync, and Automatic Zero-Restart Instant Activation.

PixelBoard is engineered with an independent coexistence package ID (com.akshaykadam.pixelboard), allowing you to install and use it side-by-side with your factory Gboard without replacing, uninstalling, or risking system keyboard stability.

Screenshots

Key Features

  • Gemini "Rambler" Natural Voice Typing: Speaks naturally by filtering out stutters and filler words ("um", "ah"), auto-corrects self-corrections on the fly, auto-punctuates sentences, and includes an ergonomically minimizable voice toolbar.
  • In-Line AI Writing Assistant: One-tap proofreading, grammar fixes via interactive suggestion chips, and quick tone rewrite (Professional, Casual, Concise, Emotive) across every application.
  • In-App Updater: Built-in update checker directly inside Settings to check for new releases, view changelogs, and download & install the latest PixelBoard APKs seamlessly.
  • Extended Clipboard Retention: Customizable retention duration (1 hour, 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, or Never) with recent unpinned history expanded to 100 clips, floating screenshot chips, and reliable clipboard sync on Samsung One UI & Vivo.
  • Modern Spell Checker & Grammar Chips: Interactive clickable suggestion chips, grammar checks, and native red squiggly underlines on misspelled words across all apps.
  • Scan Text (Camera OCR): Direct camera viewfinder tool in the toolbar to capture and extract text directly at your cursor from real-world documents.
  • Material 3 Expressive Styling: Pill-shaped rounded keycaps (Belka UI), Google Sans Flex variable typography, and restored vibrant emoji scaling with dedicated emoji tabs.
  • Proactive Suggestion Strip Undo: 1-tap Undo button right in the suggestion strip to instantly reverse unwanted autocorrections or accidental text deletions.
  • Side-by-Side Coexistence: Installs as an independent package (com.akshaykadam.pixelboard) alongside your stock keyboard with bypassed signature verification.

Note

Google Pixel Device Support: Advanced on-device inference (Private AICore / Astrea) is available only on Google Pixel devices. Core Rambler Natural Voice Typing, AI Writing Assistant, proofreading, and tone rewrite work across all Android devices.

How to Enable Rambler Voice Typing

Follow these quick steps to activate Google's Gemini-powered Rambler natural voice typing:

  1. Open PixelBoard Settings:
    • Tap the Gear (⚙️) icon in the keyboard suggestion strip, or go to Android Settings > System > Languages & input > On-screen keyboard > PixelBoard.
  2. Select Rambler Dictation:
    • Tap Voice typing.
    • Under Dictation type, choose Rambler (switch selection from Standard to Rambler).
  3. Instant Automatic Activation (No Restart Needed):
    • Your selection activates automatically in real-time — no app restart or device reboot required!
    • (Optional): You can verify that Enable Advanced Voice Typing is toggled ON under ★ Advanced settings (enabled by default). The toolbar Restart (↻) button remains available as an optional manual fallback if ever needed.

    Tip

    Thanks to recent runtime enhancements, Rambler dictation initializes dynamically on the fly. You can immediately tap the microphone icon without needing to restart Gboard or kill the app process!

  4. Start Speaking Naturally:
    • Tap any text box and hit the Microphone icon on PixelBoard.
    • You will see the "Just speak naturally" setup screen.
    • Tap Get started and speak freely — PixelBoard handles the cleanup automatically!

Where to Find & Use AI Writing Tools

Google's AI Writing Tools allow you to proofread, rephrase, and adjust the tone of any text on the fly.

1. Where to Configure

  • In Advanced Settings:
    • Open ★ Advanced settings from the bottom of PixelBoard Settings.
    • Make sure Enable AI Writing Tools and Support All Keyboards are toggled ON (both ON by default).
  • In Corrections & Suggestions:
    • In PixelBoard Settings, go to Corrections & suggestions > Writing tools.
    • Ensure Show writing tools icon in suggestion strip while typing is enabled.

2. Where to Access While Typing

  • Suggestion Strip (Quick Bar):
    • When typing in any text box across any app, the Writing tools icon (pen sparkle ✨) appears in the keyboard suggestion strip above your keys.
  • Keyboard Tools Menu:
    • If the icon is hidden, tap the 4-squares / arrow icon on the left of the suggestion strip to open the tools drawer and tap Writing tools.
  • Actions Available:
    • Proofread: One-tap fix for grammar and spelling.
    • Rewrite / Rephrase: Adjust tone between Professional, Casual, Concise, and Emotive.

⚙️ Advanced Settings Screen

PixelBoard features a clean, minimal preference screen modeled directly after the native Material You Gboard UI:

  • Enable AI Writing Tools: Force-shows the Writing tools icon in the suggestion strip across all apps and text views.
  • Support All Keyboards: Extends AI writing assistance beyond English to all keyboard layouts.
  • Inference Backend Type: On supported hardware, select between GBOARD_SERVER, PRIVATE_INFERENCE_AICORE, and PRIVATE_INFERENCE_ASTREA.
  • Enable Advanced Voice Typing: Unlocks the Rambler dictation engine in Voice typing settings.
  • In-App Updates: Built-in OTA updater to check for new releases, view changelogs, and download & install updates directly from GitHub.
  • Rounded Keys: Enable Google's Material 3 Expressive Belka pill-shaped keycaps.
  • Multilingual Support: Fully localized in 20+ languages matching your device's system locale.
  • Toolbar Restart Button (↻): Optional one-tap process reload utility in the toolbar if you ever want to force a refresh, though all settings and toggles apply automatically in real time without restarts.
  • Cleaned Preferences: Promotional bloatware ("Rate Gboard" and "Help & feedback") has been completely removed.
  • Custom Attribution: Dedicated credit footer (Akshay Kadam).

Installation Guide

Option A: Direct Download on Your Phone (Easiest)

  1. Download PixelBoard Stable APK (v1.3.6, 122 MB) (or view the v1.3.6 Release Page).
  2. Tap the downloaded .apk in your notification drawer or Downloads folder.
  3. If prompted, toggle "Allow from this source" and tap Install.
  4. Enable PixelBoard in Settings > System > Languages & input > On-screen keyboard.

Option B: Sideload via ADB (For Developers)

Connect your Android phone via USB with USB Debugging enabled:

adb install -r PixelBoard-1.3.6.apk
adb shell am force-stop com.akshaykadam.pixelboard

(If building from source locally, use adb install -r output/PixelBoard-1.3.6.apk)

Option C: Patch via Morphe Manager (On-Device Patcher)

You can patch your stock Gboard APK directly on your phone using Morphe Manager:

  1. Install Morphe Manager on your Android device.
  2. Get the two required files:
    • Patch Bundle: PixelBoard.mpp (or versioned patches-1.3.6.mpp)
    • Stock Base APK: Download the official base bundle from APKMirror (Gboard v18.6.3.100 Release).
  3. In Morphe Manager, select Storage, choose the stock Gboard APK, and load PixelBoard.mpp as the patch source.
  4. Tap Patch and then Install!

Important

Strict Version Requirement: The patch bundle only works on Gboard version 18.6.3.100 (18.6.3.1002251336-release-arm64-v8a). Kernel-based Android Root Solution & KPM

https://SukiSU.org

SukiSU Nova

English 简体中文 |

A kernel-based root solution for Android, evolved from tiann/KernelSU with some interesting changes added.

Features

  1. Kernel-based su and permission management.
  2. App Profile: keep root access in a cage.
  3. KPM support.
  4. Built-in Zygisk (NyaZygisk) — no separate Zygisk module needed; running status is shown right on the home screen.
  5. Theme Store: browse, install and submit themes, with multi-source mirrors, author authorization and review.
  6. Kernel Extension Center: CPU/vvar spoofing, AVC log spoofing, version spoofing, SUSFS and mount view hiding — all in one place.
  7. Built-in SUSFS management tools with one-tap root hiding configuration.
  8. Dual UI: Miuix / Material 3 Expressive; supports Miuix splash screen, module banners and sorting, temporary root grant, and kernel-free preview.

Compatibility

  • SukiSU Nova supports GKI 2.0 devices (kernel version 5.10 and above).
  • Older kernels are also compatible (minimum 4.14+), but you need to compile the kernel yourself.
  • With additional backports, 3.x kernels (3.4–3.18) can be supported.
  • Currently supported architectures: arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a (bare), X86_64, riscv64.
  • Note: This project has evolved independently since forking from tiann/KernelSU; compatibility is based on testing in this repository and no longer equals the official KernelSU support scope.

Kernel Compatibility Status

Scenario Method Notes
GKI devices (kernel 5.10+) LKM mode recommended
Non-GKI / old kernels (3.0+) Compile the kernel manually Please refer to the integration guide on the website
KPM features required Requires CONFIG_KPM=y See "KPM Support" below

KPM Support

Developed based on KernelPatch, with features duplicating KernelSU removed — only KPM support is kept.

Current status:

  • ✅ Basic KPM loading is available (requires CONFIG_KPM=y)
  • 🚧 The APatch compatibility layer is still being completed (some features are not yet merged)
  • ⚠️ Non-GKI devices additionally require CONFIG_KALLSYMS=y and CONFIG_KALLSYMS_ALL=y
  • ⚠️ Kernels below 4.19 need set_memory.h backported from 4.19

Open-source repository: ShirkNeko/SukiSU_KernelPatch_patch
KPM template: udochina/KPM-Build-Anywhere

Troubleshooting

  1. KPM fails to load?
    Make sure the kernel has CONFIG_KPM=y enabled; Non-GKI devices also need CONFIG_KALLSYMS=y and CONFIG_KALLSYMS_ALL=y.

  2. The manager doesn't recognize root?
    Make sure the flashed kernel matches the manager version, and check whether su is in PATH.

  3. Kernel compilation errors?
    Refer to guide/how-to-integrate.md, and make sure the kernel version meets the minimum requirement (4.14+).

item.title: madkongo/CallVault
item.description:
FOSS call recorder for Android, no root or PC — records both sides of a call on its own over built-in ADB, or through Shizuku if you already use it. Fork of ShizuCallRecorder.

Records your calls, transcribes them, and summarises them — all on the phone itself.

Free, no ads, no accounts. Nothing leaves your phone unless you switch on Drive backup.

Recording call audio needs shell-level privilege. CallVault gets it one of two ways — pick either in the setup wizard, and switch whenever you like:

Built-in (default) Shizuku
Pairs once, on the phone itself. No other app, no PC. Already run Shizuku? Nothing to pair — choose it and go.

Compare the two ↓

CallVault is a fork of ShizuCallRecorder (Copyright © kitsumed (Med)), re-architected to run self-contained over embedded ADB, so it no longer needs Shizuku — and still runs through it, as a second mode, if you prefer. It is a modified, independent version — not endorsed by or affiliated with the original author. See NOTICE.md.

What it does

  • 🎙️ Phone calls, both sides — automatically, or ask-me-each-time.
  • 💬 App calls — WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram and others, and you pick which apps get recorded. Opt-in.
  • 🎛️ Controls while you talk — pause, resume, stop, or mark a moment to find again later. On phone calls and app calls alike.
  • 🔗 Merge calls that were one conversation — a call drops and you ring back; join them into one recording, in the order you choose. Lossless, and un-mergeable afterwards.
  • 📝 Transcripts — 13 languages, written on the phone.
  • 🧾 Summaries — intent, key points, decisions, action items.
  • 🗣️ Speaker labels — who said which line, on phone calls.
  • 🔎 Search — a contact on the Recordings page, a word across transcripts or summaries, right on the page.
  • 🏷️ Tags and stars — label a call, star the ones worth keeping, filter the list by either.
  • 📤 Export a transcript as text, Markdown, SRT, VTT or JSON.
  • ▶️ Playback with a waveform you can scrub, plus a note per call.
  • 🔒 App lock — your phone's own unlock, required before any recording or transcript is shown. Optional.
  • ☁️ Google Drive backup — optional.
  • 🧹 Housekeeping — delete recordings past a chosen age, cap how much space they may use, or drop very short ones. All off by default, and a starred recording is never deleted automatically.
  • 🔔 Says when it has stopped working — if recording can't start after a reboot, or recordings stop reaching Drive, it tells you rather than leaving you to find out from a call that is not there.
  • 🔄 In-app updates — checks GitHub, verifies the signature, installs on your tap. Never on its own.

Recordings are Opus in an .ogg file at 24 kbps by default (AAC/.m4a also available, 8–128 kbps), saved to a folder you pick and can open in any other app. CallVault can also write BCR's metadata file beside each recording — off by default — so tools built for BCR, such as bcr-gui, can read your calls' details.

Note

App-call capture depends on your phone's audio stack and on each app's own build. Verified so far on OnePlus 12 (OxygenOS 16) and Galaxy S24 FE (One UI 8.5) — reports welcome. Carrier Wi-Fi calling (VoWiFi/VoLTE) is not covered, and an app call that starts before CallVault is ready is lost rather than recorded late — the routing is fixed the moment the call begins. Bluetooth headsets are fine, including AirPods; only LE Audio is untested.

Main screen Recordings Playback & summary Transcript
Search Transcripts settings Recordings settings

Transcripts and summaries

Both run on the phone, on the CPU, with no account and no network.

Transcription uses whisper.cpp. Two models — 190 MB, or 574 MB for better quality — downloaded once over Wi-Fi.

Summaries use llama.cpp with Google's Gemma. It is a 2.6 GB download and needs a similar amount of memory to run, so it wants a recent phone; CallVault states the cost before it downloads anything.

Speaker labels come from the call's own two channels, not from a voice model, so they cost nothing extra. One tap tells CallVault which side is you, and it renames every past phone call too. App calls stay as Speaker A and Speaker B.

Note

Pick your language rather than leaving it on auto-detect — detection is unreliable and can transcribe a language phonetically into the wrong alphabet. A long call is transcribed in passes and takes a while, but it is not refused.

What leaves your device

Leaves the phone?
Recordings Only if you turn on Google Drive backup
Transcripts, summaries, notes Never
Speaker names, contacts, call log Never
Analytics, telemetry, crash reports None exist

CallVault reaches the network in three places, and nowhere else: GitHub, to check for a new release (on by default, roughly daily); Hugging Face, to download a model you asked for; and your local network during pairing, to find the phone's own debugging service. Drive backup goes through Android's own file picker using the Drive app already on your phone — there is no login in CallVault, and it never talks to Google's servers itself.

Requirements

  • Android 11+, 64-bit ARM (arm64-v8a). On Android 11 the screen must stay unlocked during a call.
  • Developer options stay on — in built-in ADB mode. Turn them off and recordings come out empty; the Home screen warns you.
  • Room for a model if you want transcripts (190 MB or 574 MB) or summaries (2.6 GB, plus the memory to run it).

Important

CallVault leans on hidden Android APIs, so behaviour varies by OEM and can break on a new Android release. On phones that aggressively kill background apps (OxygenOS, MIUI, One UI), allow it in Auto-launch and exclude it from battery optimisation — see dontkillmyapp.com.

On OPPO, OnePlus and Realme phones there is one extra switch to flip before anything works — see below.

Two ways to run it

Built-in mode is CallVault's own, and the default. It pairs once, on the phone, and needs no second app at all. It is the default because it can do more, not because Shizuku is an afterthought.

Already running Shizuku? CallVault supports it directly. Choose Shizuku mode and there is nothing to pair, no wireless debugging to switch on, and CallVault starts no debugging of its own — it borrows the privilege Shizuku already holds. Phone calls record, and everything that happens afterwards — transcripts, summaries, search, tags, playback and export — is identical. What differs is capture-side only.

Switch whenever you like; any setting a mode couldn't honour comes back when you switch away. The table is the honest difference between the two.

Built-in mode Shizuku mode
In both modes
Phone calls, both sides ✅ ✅
Transcripts, summaries, search, tags, playback and export ✅ ✅
Where they differ
Works without installing another app ✅ ❌
Nothing to pair, and no wireless debugging of CallVault's own ❌ ✅
After a reboot, recording starts again by itself once the phone is on Wi-Fi ✅ Only with Shizuku's own auto-start (Android 13+, trusted Wi-Fi)
App calls (opt-in, Android 14+) ✅ ✅
Speaker labels ✅ ✅
Keeps recording if Android kills the background process (opt-in) ✅ ✅
Recording away from Wi-Fi (opt-in) ✅ ❌
Full bug-report export ✅ ❌

Important

After every reboot, the phone has to be on Wi-Fi once before CallVault can record — in either mode. Android clears the debugging access CallVault starts from on every reboot, and it can only be set up again over Wi-Fi. Any network will do, for a few seconds, with no internet needed — your home Wi-Fi joining automatically, or another phone's hotspot. There is no one-time setup that removes this without root. CallVault tells you when it is waiting, so a missed call is not how you find out.

Note

Recording away from Wi-Fi needs USB debugging switched on — see the two debugging switches. It is armed over your network, and a reboot clears it. It comes back as soon as the phone joins any Wi-Fi network for a few seconds — it needs no internet, and a café or a hotspot will do. CallVault says when that is needed, so a missed call is not how you find out.

Install

Download CallVault.apk from Releases, or add the repo to Obtainium for automatic updates.

Important

Recording calls is regulated, and the rules differ sharply between countries and states — often every party must consent. This is your responsibility, not the app's. Where it helps, you can turn recording off for individual apps, or have CallVault ask each time rather than record automatically. Read the disclaimer before you use it.

CallVault can't be on Google Play — Play bans both call recording and the privilege mechanism it depends on. F-Droid is planned.

Then open it and follow the setup wizard: accept the disclaimer, grant permissions, pair once (or pick Shizuku), and choose where recordings are saved.

Pairing, step by step

  1. Turn on Wireless debugging — Settings → System → Developer options. CallVault detects it and offers a shortcut if it's off.
  2. On CallVault's Permissions screen, tap Pair. It opens the Wireless-debugging screen and waits.
  3. Tap Pair device with pairing code and type the six digits into CallVault's notification.
  4. Paired ✓ — tap it to go back and finish the wizard.

If a recording stops when you lock the screen, set Default USB configuration to Charging only. CallVault offers this during setup and from Settings.

Warning

Not while you are using Shizuku, and not during a call. Changing the Default USB configuration restarts Android's debugging service. Shizuku's server is hosted by it and stops too, so you would have to start Shizuku again before anything could be recorded — and doing it mid-call ends the recording in progress. CallVault now declines the change while a recording is live.

Warning

Keep the pairing: uninstalling CallVault wipes it and there is no way to restore it — you pair again from scratch.

The two debugging switches

Both live in Developer options, and they do different jobs. You don't need both on all the time.

  • Wireless debugging is how CallVault gets in. It uses it to pair, and to start its recorder again after a reboot or an update. It only works on Wi-Fi — Android refuses it otherwise, asks you once to trust each new network, and turns it off when Wi-Fi drops.
  • USB debugging keeps the recorder alive away from Wi-Fi. No cable is involved. With it on, CallVault can switch Wireless debugging off after using it, and recording away from Wi-Fi becomes possible.
Your setup On Wi-Fi Away from Wi-Fi
USB debugging on + Recording away from Wi-Fi on (recommended) ✅ ✅
USB debugging on ✅ ✅ until the recorder has to restart, then it waits for Wi-Fi
USB debugging off, Wireless debugging on ✅ ❌
Both off ❌ ❌

Warning

Turning USB debugging off stops the recorder, even with Wireless debugging on — Android restarts its debugging service when the USB setting changes. On Wi-Fi, CallVault starts it again within a few seconds. Away from Wi-Fi it can't, and the notification says so.

If you switch Wireless debugging off yourself, CallVault leaves it off. The notification says recording is paused and has a button to turn it back on. If you'd rather CallVault switch it back on for you, turn on Keep Wireless debugging on for recording in the Recordings page's settings, under Connection (classic layout: Settings ▸ General ▸ Experimental; you're also asked during setup).

In Shizuku mode, Shizuku runs inside the same debugging service, so anything that restarts it stops Shizuku: turning USB debugging off, or arming recording away from Wi-Fi in built-in mode. Start Shizuku again from its app — CallVault tells you when that's needed and reconnects on its own once Shizuku is back. Shizuku started after USB debugging is already off keeps running.

On OPPO, OnePlus and Realme phones

ColorOS, OxygenOS and Realme UI refuse ADB permission grants out of the box. CallVault pairs, and then the privilege it needs is quietly denied — so recordings never start. This affects Shizuku mode too; Shizuku reports it as "the permission of adb is limited".

One switch fixes it, and it is not in an obvious place:

  1. Open Settings → System → Developer options.
  2. Scroll to the bottom of the Apps section — it is the last item there.
  3. Turn on Disable system optimization. Older builds call it Disable permission monitoring.

Can't see it? It is hidden in some translations, which is why people conclude their update removed it. Set the phone's language to English, turn the switch on, then set the language back — it stays on.

Flip it before pairing. If you already paired, restart CallVault afterwards: a session that started earlier keeps the permissions it had at the time.

Get in touch

Join the CallVault group on Telegram — the quickest way to ask a question, report something odd, or hear about a new build. Bug reports are still welcome as GitHub issues, which is the better place for anything that needs a log attached.

What's next

  • Speaker names for app calls — WhatsApp and Signal transcripts still read "Speaker A"; phone calls already get real names.
  • F-Droid — so updates arrive through a store rather than a download.

Building from source

git clone --recursive https://github.com/madkongo/CallVault.git
cd CallVault
./gradlew assembleRelease

Needs JDK 17, the Android NDK (27.2.12479018) and CMake — the transcription and summary engines are built from source. Without a keystore at signing/callvault-signing.keystore the release APK builds unsigned; sign it yourself before installing.

Code shrinking stays off: the privileged recorder is launched out-of-process by app_process from a class named in a string, so R8 cannot see it as reachable and strips it.

  • libadb-android — the embedded ADB client
  • whisper.cpp and llama.cpp — on-device transcription and summaries
  • Gemma by Google — the summarisation model, Apache-2.0, downloaded on request rather than bundled

OpenTune

A free music player for the YouTube Music catalogue, with no ads, no account and no subscription. It runs on Android phones and TVs, Windows, macOS, Linux and in the browser. Sign in only if you want your likes and playlists.

Get it

Where How

On Android, arm64-v8a fits almost every recent phone and universal runs on anything. Each release lists the SHA-256 checksums of its files, and the app checks for updates once a day and can update itself.

Listening

  • Plays the best stream it can find, and upgrades mid-song without a gap.
  • Crossfade and Automix, loudness levelling, a 15-band equalizer and AutoEq corrections for more than 8,000 headphones.

Your library

Look and feel

Around the phone

item.description:
Block ads system-wide on Android using local VPN-based DNS filtering. No root needed. No data collection.

https://blockads.pwhs.app

BlockAds

BlockAds is a free, open-source ad blocker for Android.

It blocks ads, trackers, and malware system-wide using local VPN-based DNS filtering — no root required, no data collection.

Built with Jetpack Compose and Material 3 for a modern, premium experience.





Download



Screenshots

Features

  • Dual Routing Modes: System-wide ad blocking via VPN (no root needed) OR Root Proxy Mode (via iptables)
  • Privacy-first Optional Crash Reporting & Manual Local Logs Export
  • Comprehensive Onboarding Flow (Permissions, Battery Optimization, Opt-in telemetry)
  • WireGuard Profile Import
  • HTTPS Filtering with userspace TCP/IP stack — per-app MITM, cosmetic CSS, JS scriptlets
  • CA cert install verification (auto-refresh after returning from Settings)
  • 284-domain curated passthrough list keeps banking, payments and gov apps working
  • Multiple built-in filter lists (StevenBlack, AdGuard DNS, EasyList, and more)
  • Region-aware defaults — auto-enables filters for your language
  • Real-time DNS query logs with search & filtering
  • Security protection — blocks phishing, malware, and malvertising domains
  • Dark / Light / System theme with Material 3 dynamic colors
  • 7 accent color options + Material You dynamic theming
  • Quick Settings tile & home screen widget
  • Custom block/allow rules and whitelisting
  • Per-app filtering (bypass VPN for selected apps)
  • DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) support with multiple providers
  • Auto-update filter lists on schedule (6h / 12h / 24h / 48h)
  • Export / Import settings backup
  • Auto-reconnect on boot
  • Multi-language support (English, Vietnamese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Thai, Spanish)
  • 100% local — all data stays on your device

Community

Join our community:

Sponsor

If you enjoy BlockAds, consider supporting the project! Your sponsorship helps us maintain and improve the app.

Build Instructions

Requirements

  • Android Studio Ladybug or newer
  • JDK 17 or higher
  • Android SDK 36 (min SDK 24)
  • (Optional - only needed if modifying Go tunnel) Go 1.23+ and gomobile

Steps

Tip

Historical versions of the Go binary (tunnel.aar) were committed in the past before being moved to GitHub Releases. To avoid downloading ~1.2GB of old binaries, use blobless clone (--filter=blob:limit=1m) to download only ~20MB.

  1. Clone the repository:

    git clone --filter=blob:limit=1m https://github.com/pass-with-high-score/blockads-android.git
cd blockads-android

    (Or for a shallow clone: git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/pass-with-high-score/blockads-android.git)

  2. (Optional) Build the Go tunnel AAR/JAR from source (with Android 15 16KB page size support):

    ./scripts/build_tunnel.sh
# Or
./gradlew -Ptunnel.source=local buildGoTunnel

    Note: This is completely optional. Gradle automatically resolves a prebuilt, checksum-pinned tunnel.aar from GitHub Releases by default. You do not need Go or NDK unless you are modifying Go code in tunnel/. See docs/TUNNEL.md.

  3. Open the project in Android Studio

  4. Sync Gradle and run the app on a device or emulator

  5. Build from command line:

    ./gradlew assembleDebug
./gradlew bundleRelease   # requires signing key

How It Works

BlockAds routes DNS queries locally either through a VpnService (Vpn Mode) or via iptables redirection (Root Proxy Mode). These queries are matched against loaded filter lists using a memory-efficient Trie data structure. Matching queries are blocked locally, while all other traffic passes through normally — no data leaves your device.

When HTTPS Filtering is enabled, a userspace TCP/IP stack (gVisor netstack via tun2socks) terminates each TCP/UDP flow in Go, looks up the owning app UID via Android's ConnectivityManager.getConnectionOwnerUid(), and only MITMs flows from selected browsers. Cert-pinned apps and the 284-domain curated passthrough list bypass MITM cleanly. Cosmetic CSS rules and EasyList ##+js(…) / AdGuard #%#//scriptlet(…) scriptlets are injected into HTML responses via a tiny in-memory local asset host.

  • Built with Jetpack Compose, Koin, and Compose Destinations

item.title: EchoMusicApp/Echo-Music
item.description:
An YouTube Music Client

https://echomusic.fun

A modern Android music app with ad-free streaming, synced lyrics, offline playback, and an intuitive user experience.

Achievements

Overview

Echo Music delivers a seamless, premium listening experience by leveraging YouTube Music's vast library — without the ads. It adds powerful extras including offline downloads, real-time synchronized lyrics, and environment-aware music recognition.

Important

In-app OTA updates have been permanently removed. Please update manually via the website. Echo Music is completely free and ad-free; the few ads shown during a manual download help support the ongoing development of this project. Please do not open issues requesting to bring this back. Thank you for your support!

Community

Discord: Join the Echo Music Discord server

Sponsor

Table of Contents

  • Overview
  • Screenshots
  • Features
  • Echo Connect (Cross-Device Sync & Handoff)
  • 320 kbps Audio Extension
  • Lossless Audio Extension
  • Installation & Setup
  • Support the Project

Screenshots

Home Screen

 Material Player

 Apple Style Player
Synchronized Lyrics

 Music Library

Features

What's New

Music DNA (New!) — Instantly uncover the backstory of any track. Echo Music queries Genius for deep track annotations, and intelligently falls back to Wikipedia API extracts for regional or obscure tracks where crowd-sourced meanings are missing.


Streaming & Playback
  • Ad-Free — Stream without any interruptions.
  • Lossless & Hi-Res Audio Streaming — Stream uncompressed studio-quality FLAC/ALAC up to 24-bit/192kHz with the lossless-extension.
  • High-Quality 320 kbps Streaming — Stream crystal-clear 320 kbps audio with the 320kbs-extension.
  • Data Saver Mode — Reduce data consumption when streaming on cellular networks.
  • Seamless Playback — Switch effortlessly between audio-only and video modes.
  • Background Playback — Listen while using other apps or with the screen off.
  • Offline Mode — Download tracks, albums, and playlists via a dedicated download manager.
  • Crossfade — Smooth transitions between tracks.
  • Canvas Animations — Visual animations while playing music.
Discovery & Echo Find
  • Echo Find — Identify songs playing around you using advanced audio recognition.
  • Echo Brain — An intelligent, on-device engine that analyzes your listening momentum and auto-injects perfectly aligned tracks into your queue.
  • Smart Recommendations — Personalized suggestions based on your listening history.
  • Comprehensive Browsing — Explore Charts, Podcasts, Moods, and Genres.
Lyrics

  • Multiple Lyric Animations — Choose from various lyric display styles.

  • Word-by-Word Lyrics — Precise per-word synchronization.

  • Lyrics+ — New lyrics provider for improved accuracy and coverage.

  • AI Translation — Built-in Google Translate integration for lyrics in any language.

    For AI lyrics translation, select API Route in the AI settings, enter your API key, and choose a model available to that key. The preset uses https://global.api-route.com/v1/chat/completions with claude-fable-5-1; you can enter another exact model ID from the authenticated /v1/models catalog using the custom model option. Model availability depends on your key's group and permissions. See the quickstart.

Integrations
  • Music Sharing via Odesli — Share songs as Song.link for cross-platform listening.
  • Set as Ringtone — Directly set any song as your device ringtone.
Smart Playback
  • Pause on Mute — Auto-pause when your device is muted.
  • Resume on Bluetooth — Playback resumes when headphones or earbuds reconnect.
Customization
  • UI Density Scale — Adjust interface spacing to your preference.
  • High Refresh Rate Support — Smoother UI and animations on supported displays.
  • Fluid UI & Animations — Material 3 Emphasized easing and GPU-accelerated lyrics for a silky smooth, lag-free experience.
  • Hide Player Thumbnail — Keep the player minimal without album art.
  • Crop Album Art — Adjust album art display to fit your style.
  • Hide Video Songs — Filter out video content from your feed.
  • Hide YouTube Shorts — Keep Shorts out of your music browsing.

Echo Connect (Cross-Device Sync & Handoff)

Echo Connect links Echo Music (Android) with Echo Music Desktop over your local Wi-Fi network — with zero cloud servers.

Key Capabilities

  • 6-Digit Device Pairing: Open Settings → Echo Connect (right below Account) and tap your Desktop to generate a 6-digit code (auto-refreshes every 60s), or initiate pairing from Desktop and enter the code in the Android popup.
  • Automatic Google Account Login: Automatically signs Desktop into your YouTube Music Google account upon binding.
  • Bidirectional Local & Spotify Playlist Sync: Keeps locally created playlists synced between Android and Desktop with zero overlap/duplicates, and syncs your connected Spotify playlists to Desktop's Library.
  • Podcast Progress Sync: Merges episode timestamps and finished status across devices.
  • 5-Minute Auto-Sync & Force Sync: Automatically syncs every 5 minutes in the background, with a Force Sync button and timestamped sync history log showing what synced and when.
  • Seamless Playback Handoff & Remote Control: Switch playback between This Phone and your paired Desktop from the player's audio output sheet or Settings → Echo Connect. Control play/pause, exact seek position, next/previous, volume, shuffle, and repeat from either device.

📖 Full Guide: See docs/ECHO_CONNECT.md for step-by-step setup, pairing, sync details, and troubleshooting.

320 kbps Audio Extension

Want to experience crystal-clear, high-bitrate 320 kbps audio in Echo Music?

By default, YouTube Music delivers standard streaming quality. Echo Music includes built-in support for third-party extension sources, allowing you to stream high-fidelity 320 kbps audio directly within the app using the official 320 kbps extension!

Visit the official repository to get started:
https://github.com/EchoMusicApp/320kbs-extension

How to Enable 320 kbps Audio:

  1. Visit the Extension Repository:

    • Go to EchoMusicApp/320kbs-extension.
    • Follow the setup and deployment instructions in the repository to deploy or obtain your extension server endpoint.

  2. Add the Server in Echo Music:

    • Open the Echo Music app on your Android device.
    • Tap your profile avatar in the top-right corner to open the Account sheet.
    • Tap Extensions to open the Extension Sources settings.
    • Scroll down to the Add new section and tap Add Custom Server.
    • Enter a name (such as 320kbps Audio) and paste your server's endpoint URL.
    • Save the server.

  3. Set Playback Priority:

    • In the Extensions menu, ensure Prefer Extension Audio is toggled ON.
    • With this enabled, Echo Music will automatically search and stream high-bitrate 320 kbps audio from your extension before falling back to YouTube Music.
    • Enjoy studio-quality 320 kbps playback with real-time format and bitrate indicators on the now playing screen!

Lossless Audio Extension

Want to experience studio-master Lossless (FLAC / ALAC) and Hi-Res Audio (up to 24-bit / 192 kHz) directly in Echo Music?

Echo Music features a dedicated lossless audio pipeline with bit-perfect DAC pass-through, real-time Bluetooth codec telemetry (LDAC, aptX HD), and live format badges (FLAC, Hi-Res, Bit-Perfect). By connecting the official Lossless Extension, you can stream uncompressed, bit-perfect music from lossless providers directly within the app!

Visit the official repository to get started:
https://github.com/EchoMusicApp/lossless-extension

How to Enable Lossless Audio:

  1. Visit the Extension Repository:

    • Go to EchoMusicApp/lossless-extension.
    • Follow the setup and deployment instructions to deploy your lossless provider instance (e.g., via Vercel, Railway, Docker, or self-hosted server) or obtain your custom lossless endpoint URL.

  2. Add the Lossless Server in Echo Music:

    • Open the Echo Music app on your Android device.
    • Tap your profile avatar (or the Settings gear icon) to open the Account / Settings sheet.
    • Tap Extensions to open the Extension Sources screen.
    • Scroll down to the Add new section and tap Add Custom Server.
    • Enter your server configuration:
      • Name: e.g., Lossless FLAC or Hi-Res Audio
      • Server URL: Paste your deployed extension endpoint (e.g., https://your-lossless-server.vercel.app).
    • Tap Done to save the server.

  3. Configure Playback Priority & Audio Pipeline:

    • In the Extensions menu, ensure Prefer Extension Audio is toggled ON.
    • When enabled, Echo Music will prioritize searching and streaming uncompressed FLAC/ALAC audio from your lossless server before falling back to YouTube Music.
    • (Optional — Audiophile Hardware):
      • External USB DAC: Connect a USB DAC via OTG to automatically activate Echo Music's Bit-Perfect Audio Pipeline, bypassing Android's OS resampling engine (Bit-Perfect • 24-bit / 192 kHz).
      • Hi-Res Bluetooth: Connect headphones supporting LDAC, aptX HD, or LC3 to view real-time Bluetooth telemetry and the gold Hi-Res badge on the player.

  4. Verify Lossless Playback:

    • Play any track and expand to the full player screen.
    • Look for the format badge (e.g., FLAC 16-bit / 44.1kHz or FLAC 24-bit / 96kHz) next to the playback controls confirming that you are streaming true lossless audio!

Installation & Setup

Android Installation

Download the latest pre-compiled APK from the Releases Page.

Building from Source

  1. Clone the Repository

    git clone https://github.com/EchoMusicApp/Echo-Music.git
cd Echo-Music

  2. Configure Android SDK Create a local.properties file:

    echo "sdk.dir=/path/to/your/android/sdk" > local.properties

    (For detailed paths on Windows/macOS/Linux, refer to SETUP.md)

  3. Firebase Configuration (Optional) Firebase is required for analytics and crash reporting. See the instructions in SETUP.md for adding your google-services.json.

  4. Build the Application To build the Universal Debug variant:

    ./gradlew assembleUniversalGmsDebug

    (For optimized ARM64 builds, release builds, or other options, refer to SETUP.md)

Without the support of this incredible open-source community, none of this would be possible. Thank you to everyone who has contributed to Echo Music!

Echo Music is a fully open-source project (FOSS) created purely for educational purposes and personal use. We do not sell this application, nor do we monetize it in any way. Echo Music acts strictly as a specialized, third-party web browser and client. It simply parses the publicly available website content and APIs of YouTube and YouTube Music, rendering them in a custom user interface. NeriPlayer 是基于 Jetpack Compose + Media3 的原生 Android 音频播放器，把 网易云音乐、Bilibili、YouTube Music、自建音乐服务器 与 本地音乐 整合进统一的播放与管理体验。本地播放和 YouTube Music 公开内容支持免登录使用，访问个人媒体库需要登录对应平台。

  • 自建音乐服务器（预览版）：连接 Navidrome / OpenSubsonic，在“资源库 → 音乐服务器”浏览与搜索专辑、单曲、歌手，复用现有播放器、封面与歌词，支持本地收藏、歌单与原文件离线下载（见连接音乐服务器）。
  • 本地优先：缓存、下载文件、歌单、历史记录、设置与授权信息保存在设备本地。
  • 可选同步：歌单、收藏、最近播放与播放统计可同步到你自己的 GitHub 仓库（应用内新建时默认私有）或 WebDAV。
  • 数据自持：同步数据只写入你控制的远端，不经过维护者服务器。
  • 账号安全：默认不向第三方平台回写播放历史和统计；需要平台听歌排行或观看历史时，可在“设置 → 第三方平台登录”单独开启网易云 / Bilibili 的播放记录同步。

💡 三者相互独立

  • 音乐服务器：接入你自建的 Navidrome / OpenSubsonic 曲库。
  • 一起听服务端：在多台设备间实时同步播放状态。
  • GitHub / WebDAV 同步：同步歌单与统计等元数据，不传音频文件，也不含音乐服务器配置与凭据。

架构、启动链路与测试说明见 docs/implementation.md 与 CONTRIBUTING.md。

连接音乐服务器

Warning

预览版，缺乏充分测试，兼容性与稳定性因服务器、曲库和网络环境而异。服务器回写、一起听和配置迁移尚未接入。

  1. 在“设置 → 第三方平台登录 → 音乐服务器”填写名称、地址、用户名和密码，连接检查通过后保存。
  2. 地址填服务器基础地址，如 https://music.example.com:4533/navidrome/，可含端口和反代子路径，不要带 /app/ 或 /rest/。
  3. 打开“资源库 → 音乐服务器”，选择配置后浏览或搜索专辑、单曲、歌手，点击歌手查看其专辑。
  4. 切换分类时保留关键词，专辑内搜索只筛选当前专辑。
  5. 点击歌曲播放，或收藏、加入队列、加入本地歌单。
  6. 歌词优先读取服务端结构化歌词，不支持时使用标准歌词接口。
  7. 长按歌曲或多选后点击“下载到本地”，服务器允许时按原文件格式保存，进度与重试由下载管理负责。
  8. 下载完成后可在本地音乐的“已下载”中播放，断网或移除服务器配置后仍可使用。

机制说明

  • 目录缓存：首次打开会加载并缓存专辑、单曲、歌手三类完整目录，搜索基于本地目录，缓存 24 小时内复用。
  • 手动刷新：曲库变化后可手动刷新，刷新失败时保留已有目录。
  • 媒体加载：目录缓存只含元数据，封面按需加载，音频在播放或下载时获取。
  • 歌手头像：优先使用服务器图片，无图时取该歌手最后一首有封面歌曲的封面。
  • 凭据：配置和密码保存在本机加密存储中，普通同步不迁移。
  • 编辑配置：只能修改名称和密码；更换地址或用户名需新建配置，原歌单条目不会迁移。
  • 封面同步：封面以不含认证信息的接口地址同步，私有服务器仍需登录。
  • 多端使用：另一台 Android 设备添加相同地址和用户名后即可加载封面，桌面端暂只保留地址。

协议与客户端约定见 API 文档。

核心特性 / Key Features

🎧 播放与音质

  • 多源与本地播放：网易云音乐、Bilibili、YouTube Music 与本地音频共用一个播放队列。
  • 播放兜底：网易云音乐不可播时先降音质；开启兜底后按歌名、歌手与时长匹配 Bilibili 候选，连续失败自动跳过。
  • YouTube Music 兼容：保留并轮换有效身份 Cookie；缓存的 player.js 或播放候选失效时回退到 EJS / HLS。
  • 音效：自研 DSP 提供内置音效、10 段均衡器、AutoEQ 导入、响度均衡与 32-bit 高解析输出，关闭后完全旁路。
  • USB 独占：支持 UAC1.0 与兼容 UAC2.0 Type I PCM 的 DAC，比特完美输出，可单独关闭插入响应。
  • DLNA / UPnP 投送：在播放页输出设备面板扫描或手动添加局域网渲染器，支持无损 FLAC 直传、WAV 兼容后备与在线音源自适应直传。
  • 后台播放：切到其他应用或从最近任务划掉后，音乐通过媒体前台服务继续播放。
  • 悬浮窗保活：可选，用不可见的 1 像素窗口降低后台播放被系统冻结的概率。
  • 播放行为：淡入淡出、切歌交叉淡入淡出、蓝牙断连暂停、混音播放与音频焦点策略，启动时恢复上次进度与播放模式。
  • Bilibili 跳过：SponsorBlock 自动跳过与自定义区间，默认关闭，一起听期间不生效。

🎤 歌词

  • 逐行与逐字：支持 LRC / YRC / TTML，含高亮、翻译、音译、偏移、点击跳转与全屏歌词。
  • CC 字幕歌词：Bilibili 歌曲可使用视频 CC 字幕，可选字幕轨道，也可回退到自动字幕。
  • 来源与编辑：按偏好自动选择网易云音乐 / 酷狗 / QQ 音乐 / LRCLIB / AMLL，支持手动匹配与编辑。
  • 外部输出：悬浮歌词、状态栏歌词、SuperLyric、Lyricon、蓝牙歌词与车载显示。
  • ColorOS 锁屏岛歌词：实验功能，需要 Root 或 Shizuku，视 ROM 支持而定。

🗂️ 媒体库与本地管理

  • 收藏到网易云歌单：使用网易云音乐音源播放时，在播放页右上角三点菜单选择“收藏到网易云歌单”，选中歌单即可加入。
    • 需要登录并联网。
    • 切换到 Bilibili 或本地兜底音源后，入口隐藏。
  • 分类浏览：本地、收藏、网易云音乐、YouTube Music、Bilibili 入口；YouTube Music 可完全禁用，Bilibili 音乐可单独关闭首页分区。
  • 首页推荐：国内首页展示榜单、日推与雷达歌单。国际首页展示 YouTube Music 推荐。在「首页与启动」展开「为你推荐」，可分别显示或隐藏歌曲、歌单、专辑和艺人。两种首页的布局独立保存。
  • 搜索：按平台独立搜索，网易云音乐、Bilibili 和 YouTube Music 支持触底分页。
  • 链接识别：粘贴含标题或短链接的分享文案，即可识别网易云音乐、Bilibili 与 YouTube Music 内容。
  • 导入与批量词图：支持分享导入与文件夹扫描，可为本地歌曲一键批量匹配并嵌入歌词与封面。
  • 本地歌手与歌单：按展示艺术家聚合，支持排序、整体插入与删除撤销。
  • 歌曲百科：曲风、语种、BPM、创作团队、评论预览、相似歌曲与相关歌单。

⬇️ 下载、缓存与存储

  • 应用内下载：多平台音频下载，支持断点续传与启动恢复，默认并发 6（可调 1–8）。
  • 自定义目录：支持 SAF 目录与文件名模板，切换时自动迁移已有下载。
  • 缓存上限：音频缓存默认上限 1 GB。
  • 保留最近播放：用 0–1000 首滑块保留最近播放的歌曲，当前播放的歌曲始终受保护。
  • 本地导入缓存：在“设置 → 存储与缓存 → 清除缓存”中清理无引用的提取封面与临时扫描索引。
  • 封面保留：历史、统计等仍在使用的封面会保留，本次启动已用到的封面在下次冷启动时再判断。

🔄 同步、统计与备份

  • GitHub / WebDAV 同步：歌单、收藏、最近播放、删除记录与播放统计保存在你自己的远端。
  • 播放统计：查看曲目、艺人和专辑排行，以及收听天数、星期分布和小时分布。可按日、周、月、年或自选日期回看。开启同步后，已记录的小时收听时长可在其他设备上查看，每段收听的具体起止时间保留在录制设备上。
  • 流量统计：区分 Wi-Fi、移动网络与漫游。
  • 备份与恢复：歌单 JSON 导入导出。
  • 配置导出：默认不含登录态，可选择加密并包含授权信息。

🎨 界面与个性化

  • 双界面风格：Material You 与预览版“简洁（Clean）”，后者支持液态玻璃效果。
  • 主题与显示：动态取色、自定义背景、歌词字号与 UI 缩放（手机 0.6–1.2x，车载 0.6–1.5x）。
  • 流体背景：播放页随封面取色的 RuntimeShader 背景，响应音频（Android 13+）。
  • 桌面与车机：三种尺寸的小组件、启动器快捷方式与蓝牙车载信息发布。
  • 大屏适配：平板横屏固定显示完整歌词分栏，手机横屏可左右切换封面与歌词。

👥 一起听

  • 统一入口：播放页「更多 → 一起听」顶部通过滑块切换「云端」「局域网」，平板迷你播放器和设置页也使用同样的分组。

  • 房间同步：创建或加入房间，通过 WebSocket 实时同步。

  • 加入方式：首次加入需要邀请密钥，重连使用成员密钥。

  • 同步内容：房主 / 听众权限、循环与随机模式、时钟偏移校正与房主离线恢复。

  • 播放候选：可选共享房主的播放候选（最多 3 条），听众优先按本机音质策略解析。

  • 局域网一起听支持在同一 Wi-Fi 下自动发现房间或按地址加入。通过播放器底部音响按钮、播放页「更多」或「设置 → 一起听」管理房间，共享音频、封面和歌词。成员默认可播放和暂停。「进度」权限同时控制切歌与拖动进度，默认开启。成员也能查看统一媒体音量、调整自己设备的音量和同步偏移。房主开启成员音量权限后，成员还能拖动统一音量条调节全员音量，或单独调节房主设备。房主的权限设置会保存在本机。局域网房间与云端房间独立，暂不支持 USB 独占输出。详见模块说明。

🛟 稳定性与诊断

  • 脱机模式：自动感知网络状态，脱机时只使用本地文件与缓存。
  • 安全模式：JVM / Native 崩溃或系统 ANR 后进入安全模式，可导出日志。
  • 开发者模式：连点版本号 7 次，启用调试探针与日志查看器。

快速体验 / Getting Started

a. 下载稳定版（推荐）

在最新稳定版页面下载适合设备架构的 APK。

Important

稳定版在一批功能完成并通过测试后手动发布，但可能仍然包含尚未发现的问题。

b. 下载 Nightly 预发布版

在 GitHub Releases 中选择标有 Nightly 的预发布版。每版提供上表四种架构的已签名 APK。CI 每天 22:00（UTC+8）检查默认分支的最新提交，每个提交只发布一次 Nightly，并且只保留最新的一个 Nightly。

如果你在使用 Nightly 预发布版时遇到问题，也欢迎随时提交问题报告。请附上构建版本和复现步骤，方便我们定位问题。

c. 下载 CI 版本

  1. 前往 Android CI，下载最近一次成功构建的 Artifacts 并解压。
  2. 或访问 Telegram 频道 NeriPlayer CI Builds。

master 分支 CI 默认上传 arm64-v8a APK。

d. 本地构建

  1. 克隆仓库并初始化子模块：
    git clone --recursive https://github.com/cwuom/NeriPlayer.git
cd NeriPlayer
  2. 安装 JDK 17，用最新稳定版 Android Studio 打开并同步依赖。
  3. 运行 :playback:runtime JVM 测试或全量模块门禁时，另需 JDK 21（生产字节码目标仍为 17）。
  4. 构建并安装调试版：
    ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
  5. 首次启动阅读免责声明并完成引导，通知与本地音乐权限在你主动点按后才会申请。
  6. 需要调试工具时，在设置页连续点击 版本号 7 次启用开发者模式。

DEBUG 构建说明

  • 仅用于测试，性能和体积与发布版不同。
  • 包名为 moe.ouom.neriplayer.debug，使用橙色启动图标，名称带 DEBUG 标记，可与 Release 共存。
  • 分享的一起听邀请使用 neriplayer-debug://，也可粘贴普通邀请链接加入。
  • 完成引导后会提示 DEBUG 构建风险，确认后不再提醒，清除数据或重装后再次提示。

在 Android Studio 中运行时，选择 app 运行配置，并确认 Build Variants 中 :app 为 debug。 更新包名配置或切换分支后，先执行 Sync Project with Gradle Files，否则 IDE 可能仍沿用旧的启动包名，导致启动已安装的正式版。

发布版构建与签名流程见 CONTRIBUTING.md。

新安装直接使用 V4。若出现升级弹窗，先更新所有参与同步的设备，再确认并立即同步以迁移地址。

行为说明

  • 🔒 凭据：Token 与 WebDAV 密码保存在 Android Keystore + EncryptedSharedPreferences 中。
  • ⚠️ 传输：使用 HTTP 地址时会提示明文传输风险。
  • 🔄 调度：变更后延迟 5 秒同步，另有每小时一次的周期同步。
  • 🔀 合并：对歌单、历史、统计与删除记录做三路合并，属于后台双向同步，不是实时推送。
  • 📦 远端格式：V4 以 ZSTD 分块增量上传。
  • 🧷 写入保护：优先使用强 ETag 条件写入，坚果云等服务改为核对清单指纹。
  • 🔓 加密：远端文件未做端到端加密。

发展规划 / Roadmap

规划会随维护精力、平台可用性和社区反馈调整。

已落地的功能见 Releases 与提交历史。

问题反馈 / Bug Report

  • 反馈前先开启开发者模式（设置页点击 版本号 7 次），应用会启用普通文件日志，崩溃日志单独保存。
  • 前往 Issues，提供系统版本、机型、应用版本、复现步骤与关键日志。
  • Windows 过滤日志：adb logcat | findstr NeriPlayer
  • Linux / macOS 过滤日志：adb logcat | grep NeriPlayer

已知问题与能力边界 / Known Issues

网络

  • 请为第三方平台配置分流规则，全局代理可能导致部分接口返回异常数据。

下载

  • 使用应用内下载管理而非系统下载服务，支持断点续传与启动恢复，受应用后台生命周期约束。
  • 手动取消会清理断点与未完成文件，仅网络策略暂停或可恢复错误会保留续传状态。
  • 自定义 SAF 目录便于外部访问，但扫描、迁移与写入慢于应用私有目录。

USB 独占

  • 需要兼容的 DAC 与前台服务。息屏后中断时，请按设置页提示放开电池与后台限制。
  • UAC2 异步模式要求唯一的显式反馈端点和受支持的时钟拓扑，暂不支持隐式反馈与无法验证的拓扑。
  • 使用系统音频输出时请关闭 USB 独占。
  • 手机与 DAC 的兼容性需实机验证。

音频输出

  • 开启 32-bit 高解析输出后，响度均衡、声道平衡、音频可视化与应用内倍速会被旁路，需要这些功能时请关闭该开关。
  • DLNA / UPnP 投送需手机与渲染器处于同一局域网且允许组播或直连访问；投送期间由远端设备解码，本机 DSP 音效与倍速不作用于远端输出。

蓝牙车载

  • AVRCP 协议没有独立歌词字段，车载歌词借用曲目标题区域显示，刷新率与封面显示取决于手机系统和车机。
  • Android Auto 使用车机原生界面，项目不提供独立的 Android Automotive OS 版本。

歌词

  • 音译需要平台歌词或内嵌标签自带音译数据。
  • 生成的歌词卡片保存在应用缓存目录，可通过清理缓存释放。
  • ColorOS 锁屏岛歌词为实验功能，依赖厂商系统与 Root / Shizuku，系统升级后需重新确认可用性。

平台能力

  • Bilibili 侧重搜索、收藏夹、合集与音频播放，不提供完整视频推荐流。
  • QQ 音乐仅用于播放页元数据与歌词补全。

同步与导出

  • 远端同步文件未做端到端加密。
  • 配置导出默认不含登录态；包含授权信息时请设置加密密码并妥善保管，密码不写入导出文件，遗忘后无法找回。
  • 多端并发更新同一分支出现分叉时会提示冲突，不会强制覆盖远端提交。

其他

  • 长音频进度记忆不覆盖你手动指定的起播位置，本身也不回写第三方平台的播放历史。
  • 播放记录同步（默认关闭）：在“设置 → 第三方平台登录”分别开启。网易云的歌听满 30 秒或播完后计入听歌记录与听歌排行；Bilibili 播放时上报观看进度，账号在 B 站暂停了历史记录时不上报。上报失败不影响播放，也不会重试。
  • Bilibili SponsorBlock 通过公开接口查询跳过区间，在一起听房间内自动禁用。

隐私与数据 / Privacy

  • 不提供自己的公共云端媒体分发服务，不接入广告、第三方统计或崩溃分析 SDK。
  • 同步目标由你自己选择和保管，个人媒体数据不会汇聚到维护者控制的平台。
  • 缓存、下载文件、本地歌单、历史记录、播放统计、设置与授权信息保存在设备本地。
  • 只有你主动开启 GitHub 或 WebDAV 同步时，才会同步歌单、收藏、历史和播放统计等元数据。
  • 音频缓存、下载文件、Cookie 与播放 Token 不会上传给开发者。
  • 默认不向第三方平台回写播放历史和统计；只有你在“设置 → 第三方平台登录”开启播放记录同步后，才会以你的账号把歌曲 / 视频编号、收听时长和播放进度发送给网易云音乐或 Bilibili。
  • 配置导出默认不含登录态；选择包含时会携带授权与同步凭据，请设置密码并妥善保管。
  • 默认关闭 Android 系统云备份与设备迁移。
  • 第三方平台的访问日志与风控策略，由对应平台按其隐私政策处理。

鸣谢 / Reference

  • netease-cloud-music：网易云音乐 Golang 实现
  • bilibili-API-collect：哔哩哔哩 API 收集整理
  • ejs：External JavaScript for yt-dlp supporting many runtimes
  • accompanist-lyrics-core：歌词解析、转换与导出库
  • accompanist-lyrics-ui：卡拉 OK 歌词 Composable
  • LDDC：多平台歌词下载匹配工具，手动匹配体验参考
  • Metrolist：YouTube Music client for Android
  • 播放页初版流体背景着色器参考了 HyperCeiler 的实现。
  • BeatSync（freeman-jiang）的配对探针算法用于局域网一起听的时钟同步，上游实现也用于校验 Kotlin 移植结果。
  • AndroidX Media3 为局域网成员提供渐进式音频播放和保持音高的变速校正。
  • Java-WebSocket 用于房主的 WebSocket 服务，负责收发房间控制消息。
  • NanoHTTPD 用于房主的 HTTP 服务，向房间成员共享音源。
  • OkHttp 用于成员连接房间并读取共享音频。

参与、支持与许可 / Contributing, Support & License

  • 参与贡献：请先阅读 CONTRIBUTING.md。核心播放、本地数据、同步与恢复链路优先维护，稳定版按功能批次手动发布。
  • 支持项目：暂不接受任何形式的捐赠，欢迎通过 Issue、PR 或分享使用体验支持项目。
  • 许可证：NeriPlayer 使用 GPL-3.0 发布，可自由使用、修改和分发，分发修改版时须继续遵守 GPL-3.0，详细条款见 LICENSE。
  • Native 源码授权：说明中列出的 NeriPlayer 自有 Native 源码另有附带署名条件的替代授权，第三方源码与未列入的内容不适用。
  • 外部 Native 贡献：提交 PR 不会自动纳入该授权，只有明确记录双授权同意时才适用。
  • 第三方代码：小米超级岛歌词的 Shizuku / XMSF 网络隔离适配移植了 GPL-3.0 的 Capsulyric 源码，见 THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md。
